claim: Which lamps Blood lets the player shoot out: over 102 maps, 62 of 288 fluorescent panels (2290), 8 of 9 long ones, 6 of 14 brass lamps, 5 of 148 brass lanterns (693; each takes its light with it), a round glass lamp (676); posts, chain lamps, torches and candles none. A row of panels is one circuit: shoot one and the row goes.
evidence: E2M1 sprite 10 (693, type 416, shade -128, tx 108); E1M3 sprite 18 (676); E1M2 sprites 630-633 (2288, type 416, tx and rx 189)
use: Make panels, lanterns and globes breakable where a room is lit by them; switch the light with each (LampGroup), one pool to a lamp.
